theme: Draw-matters, hand size and flash grants
reuse: WheneverYouDraw, 'second card each turn' (57 precedent files, e.g. wolfbat.go); no maximum hand size: game/max_hand_size.go; P/T equal to cards in hand CDA (Tishana; Body of Knowledge is in batch 8 — grep before adding a second helper); 'cast spells as though they had flash' with a condition: vedalken_orrery.go, quicksilver_speedster.go, game/cast_timing.go; win the game at upkeep: docs 'Winning, losing'; 'can't attack or block unless': restrictions.go; Cat 2/2, Drake 2/2 flying, 4/4 white Elemental with flying tokens.

cards.name: Triskaidekaphile
cards.oracle_text:
You have no maximum hand size.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if you have exactly thirteen cards in your hand, you win the game.
{3}{U}: Draw a card.

cards.name: Tishana, Voice of Thunder
cards.oracle_text:
Tishana's power and toughness are each equal to the number of cards in your hand.
You have no maximum hand size.
When Tishana enters, draw a card for each creature you control.

cards.name: Kefnet the Mindful
cards.oracle_text:
Flying, indestructible
Kefnet can't attack or block unless you have seven or more cards in hand.
{3}{U}: Draw a card, then you may return a land you control to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Hoofprints of the Stag
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever you draw a card, you may put a hoofprint counter on this enchantment.
{2}{W}, Remove four hoofprint counters from this enchantment: Create a 4/4 white Elemental creature token with flying. Activate only during your turn.

cards.name: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 2/2 green Cat creature token.
{4}{G}{G}: Until end of turn, creatures you control have base power and toughness X/X, where X is the number of cards in your hand.

cards.name: Knowledge Is Power
cards.oracle_text: Creatures you control get +X/+X, where X is the number of cards you've drawn this turn.

cards.name: Alandra, Sky Dreamer
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 2/2 blue Drake creature token with flying.
Whenever you draw your fifth card each turn, Alandra and Drakes you control each get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your hand.

cards.name: Kianne, Corrupted Memory
cards.oracle_text:

As long as Kianne's power is odd, you may cast creature spells as though they had flash.
Whenever you draw a card, put a +1/+1 counter on Kianne.
